adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `update` (lines shown in diff) only re-renders the serialized `@embedding` OpenStruct and does not apply any params or persist anything, so `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` is effectively a no-op success. On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` calling `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` has no button/trigger wired to `saveChanges` (it only has `addHost` and per-host save/delete via `embeddable-host`), making that action (and the PUT route) unused in this diff. This is a real diff-grounded completeness/cleanup concern, but it doesn't appear to break the actual host CRUD flow which uses `embeddable-host` saves directly.
